text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —A lottery?
choice_data_list: Yeah, they were advertising at the shopping arcade earlier—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—...A hot spring, huh.
Come to think of it, maybe I haven't been to one in a while.
choice_data_list: And for you, here's a raffle ticket!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!
Look at you, managing to procure that on the sly.
choice_data_list: Why not try your luck with just one ticket?
Wanna try your luck with just one ticket?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Nice. Sounds interesting...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, having arrived at the lottery venue—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, since we're here...
Let's test our combined luck...!
choice_data_list: Alright, I'm definitely gonna hit it this time!
Alright, I'm definitely gonna get it this time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Stay Gold and I enthusiastically turned the lottery machine lever together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
Well look at that, hit the bullseye!
choice_data_list: I can't believe it actually hit...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well now. Either you, me, or both of us must have some crazy good luck.
choice_data_list: By the way, when are you going to use this ticket?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah~, true. What should we do, though...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...For now, I think I'm good.
Could you hold onto it for me?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"When the time is right,
I'm gonna enjoy myself to the fullest."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to that eventual day,
the "Hot Springs Trip Ticket" was put away for now...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh, 1st prize!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, judging by the looks of it, that's some top-grade meat.
We missed out on the hot springs, but this isn't bad either.
choice_data_list: Shall we cook and eat it back at the academy?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: No, wait. Since I have the chance—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Alright, the fire's just right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Stay Gold and I rented a seaside campsite where bonfires were permitted, and we were cooking Salisbury steaks there...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, this'll make great fuel for the journey...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eating that hamburg steak while gazing up at the starry sky
became an unforgettable memory from our trip—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I won something!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, that's quite a lot.
With this much—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It seems best to rely on our connections.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!
A stroke of good luck, and carrots from Stego-san!
Don't mind if I do~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since we have the chance, I think I'll try making something with Dober~
I'll share some with you once it's done~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Senpai.
I'll share some with Spe-chan too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please do.
It'd be a big help on our end too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Stay Gold shared the carrots with her classmates, making sure none of them went to waste.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Well, guess that's that.
If I hit it, that's just a bonus."
choice_data_list: Having just one makes it pretty hard to use, though.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: You think so? Something like this is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crunch, munch, munch!)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――Yeah, that was a good carrot.
choice_data_list: S-She ate it in an instant...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did you want some too?
choice_data_list: No, it's not quite like that...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Then consider it on the house.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry.
I'll make sure this single skewer nourishes my journey."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah... No good, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Even if it wasn't the hot spring trip,
I'd have been happy winning anything, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
A miss, huh...?
That's no fun at all...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It'd be a lot more entertaining if losing meant
being forced to drink super spicy juice instead—
choice_data_list: A raffle like that is just the worst...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For quite a while after, Stay Gold continued to look disappointed...
